items.name: Microchip details check
items.notes: Check the address and phone number are current on the microchip database.

items.name: Halloween fireworks plan
items.notes: Walk early before dark, close the curtains, play background noise, set up a safe den, keep his ID tag on.

items.name: Christmas food safety
items.notes: No chocolate, grapes/raisins, mince pies, cooked bones or xylitol.
